description: Allow people, places and things to reveal yourself to you 🥂 #designyourlife #chooseme #selflove
transcript: experiences are important because they shift your perspective. Over the past several weeks, various experiences have been opening my eyes to reality and the more that I find myself living in this reality, the realization that there are a lot of things that I do that I don't enjoy. There are spaces that I've occupied that I don't want to exist in anymore and that's why experiences are so important. Experiences open the door to your truest self.
